title: Signature 07 · Glamour Hourglass · Palekh · Snowy Birch
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her late 30s, long voluminous curls with a delicate gold tiara.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Glamour hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an overwhelmingly enormous full bust, a waist cinched so impossibly tiny it is barely a third of the width of her hips, hips flaring to nearly twice the width of her shoulders, thighs thicker than her waist pressing together, soft full voluptuous curves everywhere. Not skinny, not a runway model, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Russian Palekh lacquer painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Deep glossy black lacquer densely covered with fine gold-leaf vine scrolls, firebird feather ornaments, and jewel-tone red, blue, and green flowers. The gold scrolls spread wide across the bust and hips and narrow across the tiny waistline. No borders, no bands, not a corset. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing facing the camera in a relaxed contrapposto, her weight on one leg so that hip juts far outward, the other heel lifted, arms relaxed away from the body.

Footwear: Extremely high red lacquer platform stiletto mules with gold straps. Nails: extra long almond, red with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: A snowy birch forest on a bright winter morning, white snow and pale trunks, the background much lighter than her body, soft low sunlight carving the impossibly tiny waist, making the gold leaf glow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss lacquer finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
